articles.summary: EFFINGHAM, Ill., Aug. 04, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Midland States Bancorp, Inc. (Nasdaq: MSBI) announced today that its Board of Directors declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.33 per share of its common stock, an increase of 3.1% from the previous quarterly cash dividend of $0.32 per share.
articles.title: Midland States Bancorp, Inc. Increases Common Stock Cash Dividend to $0.33 Per Share and Declares Preferred Stock Dividend
